d: A Yorkshire terrier who became aggressive after going blind; a spoiled Pekingese/miniature poodle mix; a Rottweiler with a dangerous obsession with the horses on the ranch where she lives.
A Lab-greyhound mix has aggression problems; a Rhodesian Ridgeback-boxer mix has severe dog aggression.
A Yorkshire terrier barks too much; a once-shy German shepherd becomes aggressive; a shepherd mix has a whining problem.
Cesar tries to help an aggressive Shiba Inu from Japan and meets a wire fox terrier who has a fixation with a riding lawn-mower.
Cesar revisits some of his toughest cases and sees how being on the show changed not only the dogs, but the lives of the owners.
An Alaskan malamute exhibits aggressive tendencies; Cesar helps a professional dog walker with her clients.
A German shepherd and Welsh corgi mix has dog aggression; a blind Lab chases his tail when he is around food.
An aggressive bulldog; a beagle/terrier mix with a fear of trash cans; a Lab mix who starts to exhibit anxiety outside.
